script_line: Nothing to lose but the pain. Go and do your stairs.

risks.risk: she touches the rail (the user's fault)
risks.prevented_by: both hands swinging free, away from the banister; no hand on the rail

risks.risk: she reaches the camera or the camera backs away
risks.prevented_by: one step only, still mid-flight; RIG-R1C: the phone stays on the landing

risks.risk: the strap turns into a block (the image fault)
risks.prevented_by: the strap is locked line; no strap growing, no padding, no brace
